name: Lyo.FantasyFootball
tagline: Records and store contract for fantasy football chats and trades.
description: League, member, team, roster, conversation, message, and trade records, plus `IFantasyFootballStore`. No Entity Framework and no ESPN types. The HTTP API maps ESPN into these records.
features: `IFantasyFootballStore` upserts a league by ESPN league id and season, then stores chats and trades under that league.
A roster row is one player for the league scoring period, so the trade form does not call ESPN.
Conversation members are SWIDs already saved on the league.
